summary: Re-test of the coupon system after moving cart-subtotal computation server-side. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (8 new in test_coupon_iter22.py + 14 regression from iter21/edge-case/category/tamper suites). Frontend: verified the PRIMARY iteration_20 HIGH bug is FIXED - on a Rs854 cart the checkout 'Available Coupons' modal now shows eligible general coupons (WELCOME50 min 299, SAVE10 min 499, IT22GEN min 299) with ACTIVE Apply buttons even though 2 of the 5 /coupons/available requests still carry the stale subtotal=0 (server ignores the param). Applying IT22GEN (10%) reduced the total 914 -> 828.6 (=10% of 854), modal then showed 'Applied · Remove', removing restored 914. Category coupon showed reason 'Add Rs4301 more of Rice products to use' + working 'Add More' that navigates to /products?category=<rice-id>. End-to-end COD order with stacked product+delivery coupon placed successfully (subtotal 854, coupon -85.4, delivery 60, delivery coupon -60, total paid 768.6). Admin /admin/coupons form (category select, first-order switch, total + per-customer limits) saves and the card now renders category badge, First-order badge and 'Limit 7 total · 2/customer' (previous LOW issue fixed); delete works.

minor.issue: Empty-cart edge case: validating a general (non-category) coupon with an EMPTY cart returns 200 with discount 0.0 and message 'Coupon applied' instead of a 400 like the category branch ('Add <cat> items to use this coupon'). Cosmetic/UX only (order creation recomputes), but the customer sees a success toast '-Rs0'.
Still called 5x per checkout render (2x before cart resolves). Now harmless because subtotal is server-derived, but each call re-reads the cart+products; consider debouncing/memoising the effect.

integration_issues.issue: LOW: Checkout.js still sends the now-ignored `subtotal` query param and still fires the request before the cart resolves (subtotal=0). Behaviour is correct because the backend ignores it; recommend dropping the param to avoid confusion.

issues: 'Valid from' / 'Valid until' use native <input type=date> (browser mm/dd/yyyy picker) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover used elsewhere

Default-selected address can be for a different PIN (Hyderabad 500034) than the active delivery PIN (520003), so delivery charge/express options change after the user manually picks the matching address - consider auto-selecting an address matching the active pincode

action_items: Optional: return 400 ('Your cart is empty' / 'Add items to use this coupon') from /coupons/validate for general coupons when the server-derived cart subtotal is 0, instead of 200 with discount 0.
Optional cleanup: remove the unused `subtotal` query param from Checkout.js coupon fetches and debounce the effect (currently 5 calls per render cycle).
Optional: replace the native date inputs in AdminCoupons with the shadcn calendar picker; auto-select checkout address matching the active pincode.
critical_code_review_comments: coupons.py now derives cart_total/cart_by_cat once via _cart_breakdown and uses _bulk_usage_counts - the N+1 concern from iteration_20 is resolved for usage counts; _cart_category_subtotal is still used in validate_coupon (a second cart read) and could reuse _cart_breakdown.

Tests that cancel orders must use PUT /api/admin/orders/{id}/status (releases reserved inventory); the previous suite cancelled via direct Mongo writes which drained available_quantity for pincode 520003 to 0 and broke test setup. I restored that inventory (available 25 / reserved 0) and fixed both suites to cancel via the admin API.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (modal eligibility/apply/remove/add-more, stacked coupon order e2e, admin coupon CRUD)

rca_of_the_issue: iteration_20 HIGH bug (stale subtotal=0 race) is resolved at the source: /api/coupons/available and /api/coupons/validate now compute the cart total and per-category totals from the DB cart (_cart_breakdown/_cart_subtotal) and ignore the client `subtotal`. Verified by request capture: the last-resolved subtotal=0 response no longer degrades eligibility, and tampered subtotal=999999 yields a discount computed from the real cart (10% of 854 = 85.4).
